audit_area: Audit C — Crash Durability, Atomic State Persistence & Recovery

atomic_persistence_mechanism.isolation: Parent directory creation guaranteed, temp file deleted on write exception

flush_and_fsync_evaluation.implementation_detail: Uses Path.write_text(..., encoding='utf-8') followed by Path.replace().
flush_and_fsync_evaluation.risk_profile: Safe against process-level crashes, SIGKILL, and thread panics (as verified by test_audit_b_recovery_after_process_crash_while_locked and test_audit_c_atomic_state_replacement). Minor vulnerability to total hardware power loss / kernel panic before disk controller flushes OS dirty pages.
flush_and_fsync_evaluation.recommendation: Use open() with f.flush() and os.fsync(f.fileno()) before replace() for 100% power-loss durability.

test_corrupt_state_recovery.scenario: State file corrupted with truncated garbage JSON string
test_corrupt_state_recovery.result: PASSED (Broker caught json.JSONDecodeError gracefully, initialized default safe baseline, and did not crash)

test_state_data_consistency.scenario: Open trade -> Close trade -> Save -> Load new instance
test_state_data_consistency.result: PASSED (Full ledger, cash, closed_trades, and idempotency cache matched across disk reload)

data_integrity_invariants.atomic_swap_guarantee: VERIFIED (temp file write completed prior to atomic rename)
